title: Cooling matters: the other side of heat pumps
summary:
Cooling is essential to protect people’s health. Heat pumps can both heat and cool. They can also recover and reuse the heat generated when cooling. This makes them a dual-purpose technology that supports climate mitigation, adaptation and energy system flexibility.
